chosen.premise: Machoke normally keeps its belt on, but removes it only when it meets an enemy truly mighty.
chosen.hook: Machoke has an emergency full-power mode—and it starts with removing its belt.
chosen.visualIdea: Show a restrained Machoke facing a massive silhouette, then animate the belt coming off and its aura exploding.
chosen.note: The belt-removal trigger creates a strong rule and escalation. It is supported by Ultra Sun and the broader belt lore, though the dramatic full-power effect is an interpretation rather than a directly described visual.

candidates.premise: Machoke's steel-hard muscles let it hold a sumo wrestler aloft with just one finger.
candidates.hook: Machoke can lift a sumo wrestler using only one finger.
candidates.visualIdea: Animate one raised finger supporting a sumo wrestler, with a steel texture spreading across Machoke's muscles.
candidates.note: An extremely concrete and surprising feat that is easy to animate. It is a great Machoke fact, though the general super-strength premise is not exclusive to Machoke.

candidates.premise: Machoke can lift a dump truck with one hand, then uses that strength to help people with heavy jobs.
candidates.hook: Machoke's idea of helping is lifting a dump truck one-handed.
candidates.visualIdea: Split the screen between a dump truck on one hand and Machoke carrying heavy cargo for workers.
candidates.note: The dump-truck claim is concrete, absurd, and strongly supported. The helping-people contrast adds character, but the angle is primarily a strength comparison.

candidates.premise: Machoke's belt is not fashion: it suppresses overwhelming energy so its movements can be controlled.
candidates.hook: Machoke wears a belt because its own body is too powerful.
candidates.visualIdea: Zoom into Machoke's waist as an energy meter rises, then show the belt lowering it back down.
candidates.note: Machoke’s belt is a distinctive, well-supported mechanic with an instantly readable visual. Slightly less surprising because the belt lore is already familiar to many fans.

candidates.premise: Machoke evolves from Machop at level 28, but reaching its final form requires a trade.
candidates.hook: Machoke levels up normally—but its final evolution needs a trade.
candidates.visualIdea: Show Machop's level counter reaching 28 to become Machoke, then freeze the final evolution behind a trade link.
candidates.note: The level-28-to-trade progression is clear and useful, but trade evolution is a common Pokémon mechanic and not strongly tied to Machoke’s identity. The evolution methods come from a trusted secondary source.

candidates.premise: Machoke willingly does hard labor because every heavy job doubles as muscle training.
candidates.hook: For Machoke, a hard day's work is also a workout.
candidates.visualIdea: Follow Machoke from construction work to mountain training, turning each carried load into a workout counter.
candidates.note: The work-as-training idea is supported, but 'every heavy job' overstates the cited entries and the premise is broader and less punchy than the feat-based angles.

rounds.request: Stronger angles would need an even sharper contradiction or rule tied specifically to Machoke, ideally combining the belt’s suppression with a concrete feat such as the one-finger sumo or dump-truck claim, while avoiding unsupported exaggeration about what happens when the belt is removed.
